about: Task 6 pre-registered acceptance thresholds (Phase 0, 2026-10-30). Provisional values approved by the owner in Groups 1-5 (docs/TASK6_DECISIONS.md). Changes need owner approval and are recorded in docs/TASK6_PHASE0_METHODOLOGY.md section 8. 'sample' names the seed set the measure is judged on (B = 1-60 x 10 seasons, H = held-out 61-80, C = 106-115 x 20, CH = held-out 116-125). 'better' gives the direction of improvement for the supported/inconclusive classification; 'band' is the target. Measures without a band are reported against baseline only. Version 1 was set before any candidate data; after the v42.17.0 baseline was measured (Phase 0), definitions that differ from the Task 4/5 yardsticks the targets were written against were re-based or annotated (methodology section 8). Entries marked 'proposed' await the owner's review of Phase 0.

integrityProblems.how: harness problems (weekly invariants, cap, roster legality, draft-asset integrity, save round trip) across every run

determinism.how: tools/task6-harness-check.mjs: identical hashes on rerun; and the repeat baseline file's hash equals the original

nonInterference.how: tools/task6-harness-check.mjs: the game alone and under the harness end in the identical franchise

fullSuite.how: npm test on the phase's final commit; no test weakened or removed (docs/TESTING_POLICY.md)

tradingTests.how: tests/trading-second-pass.test.js and the trading files of the targeted tier

saveCompat.how: tools/save-compat-check.mjs on v42.16 and v42.17 saves (mid-season, offseason, draft); save round trip leaves the registry unchanged

ownerContract.how: tools/balance-compare.mjs persistent against legacy, seeds 1-8 x 8 seasons, every difficulty; tools/task6-balance-gates.mjs --contract

ownerDriftS1to8.how: owner win rate seasons 1-8, candidate against published v42.17.0, matched seeds 1-12 per difficulty (balance-compare persistent, board reset); tools/task6-balance-gates.mjs --drift. Point estimate within +/-5; an interval reaching past 5 is reported as inconclusive and escalated

performance.how: Stage P time per season against the v42.17.0 baseline on the same machine, measured alone

mobileBrowser.how: phone-width browser checks for every changed screen (docs/TESTING_POLICY.md section 2)

gymLeadMinS5on.conflict: v42.17.0 itself is below 6 in seasons 1-7 (C: 4.7, 5.6, 5.2 in seasons 5-7; 6.3 from season 8) and the approved plateau does not change seasons 1-10. Reported to the owner; gymLeadMinS8on is reported alongside. Not changed without approval

gymTierOrderHeld.conflict: per-seed: v42.17.0 holds the order in 90% (C) and 70% (CH) of seeds; inversions are within 0.5 points between neighbouring tiers. Pooled tier means (gymEarly/Mid/LateOvrS5on) are reported alongside. Not changed without approval

successionCoverPct.note: the approved R1 definition (within 8 OR potential at least the starter's overall): baseline 36.1% (B), 25.1% (C); reported against baseline

misalignedPosRelPct.note: position-relative yardstick (baseline 10.6%); the spec's 15% was written for the Task 4 club-relative measure (24.5%). Proposed: -30% against baseline, with r1Ovr not lower than baseline

r1StarterAt2Pct.note: Task 4 sense: starter for the drafting club at the end of the second season. Baseline 33.0%; the spec's +10.7-point intent (24.3% to 35%) gives 44%

r1StarterAt2LatePct.note: Task 4 sense, drafted in year 12 or later; baseline 14.4% matches the spec's 14%
